category_title: Unmotivated rising first graders with significant letter-sound recognition deficits and high interest in specific machinery
minimal_context: Derek is working one-on-one with a tutor at the Literacy Corner to identify magnetic letters and read nonsense words.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's look at these magnetic letters. Can you tell me the name and sound of this one?

STUDENT: That is an 'm'. It makes the 'mmm' sound.

TUTOR: Okay, now let's try to read this made-up word on the paper by putting the sounds together.

STUDENT: I don't know those letters. I am unable to read.

TUTOR: Just try your best to sound it out. What color is the first magnetic letter?

STUDENT: I don't know the color! Reading is never fun. I just want to talk about dump trucks and tractors.

options.A: Terminate the reading demands and remove the magnetic letters for 10 seconds.
options.B: Do not give Derek attention during the remainder of the nonsense word activity.
options.C: Use the magnetic letters to support Derek's understanding of the nonsense words.
options.D: Give Derek a warning, followed by a 10-minute timeout if he does not desist.
